craft_notes: Sthāyin: sealing with the maker's name (colophon joy). Sanskrit first: stavacintāmaṇim (accusative object, the jewel made) + bhūrimanorathaphalapradam + bhaktilakṣmyālayaṃ + śambho (vocative dedication) + bhaṭṭanārāyaṇo vyadhāt (maker acts, aorist — done). Feel: weight held across three epithets, then the signature falls. Device: comma line 1 (heaping held), dash→colon line 2 (wright released). Rejected: laud-gem/gravid — KILLED by owner verdict (imported ugliness, vighna; T1 wish-jewel/longing/home restored verbatim); 'made' for 'wrought' — kept wrought (vyadhāt fashioned, weightier); shortening the name — kept whole (colophon names). Read aloud: lands on Śambhu. Owner verdict 2026-11-04 (BEAUTIFUL): 'home' -> 'fortune-house' — ālaya kept as house (image, not feeling); love's fortune-house carries bhakti-lakṣmī whole.

lines: This wish-jewel of praise, heavy with granted longing,
love's fortune-house: Bhaṭṭa Nārāyaṇa wrought it for Śambhu.
